scoring_justification: Headline quantities (a0, B0, Cv) are reported by agent and compared to paper's GGA-PBEsol values; recomputation from raw E(V) curves is not possible as those are not submitted and would be heavy.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values (a0, B0, B′, Cv at 300 K) from paper Table 1 (GGA-PBEsol) and thermal results text for Cv at 300 K.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 for a0, B0, Bprime; thermal results text: 'Cv at zero pressure by PBEsol are ... 111.843 for KZnF3 and 114.0335 J/mol K for AgZnF3'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual computed values, verifying reproduction.

outputs.description: Structural parameters from Murnaghan fit (GGA-PBEsol). Hidden tolerances: a0 within 2 %, B0 within 15 %, B′ within 20 % (or comparable spread).
Quasi-harmonic Debye heat capacity at 300 K, zero pressure. Hidden tolerance: ±5 J/(mol·K).

output_contract.notes: Only a0, B0, B′ and Cv are scored, consistent with the approved plan. Tolerances are hidden to prevent gaming.
